correctness.rationale: For each unordered prefix-value set, the first record has conditional expectation equal to the reciprocal of the prefix length. Exhaustive conditional cases force every within-set covariance to vanish except when the record indices match and that prefix comprises exactly the smallest labels. This exceptional set has reciprocal-binomial probability and conditional variance equal to the usual Bernoulli variance, establishing the full matrix for every permitted size. Bernoulli factorization gives off-diagonal independence; independent relative ranks yield both count variances. Isolating three boundary indices and bounding the remaining binomial reciprocals proves the cubic-order asymptotic remainder. The attached fresh standalone verifier checked 656 exact-rational assertions and four numerical comparisons after extraction from the package; finite checks are corroborative.

value.rationale: The position-by-value cross-dependence between a permutation's upper-record positions and its inverse's upper-record positions is a natural bidirectional ranking statistic. The diagonal full-except-one-rank law identifies exact independence of every nonmatching coordinate, localizes dependence to a complete-prefix-block event, and yields quantitative decay with the reciprocal of sample size times its logarithm of aggregate correlation. This is a complete structural sign/zero classification with a plausible role in two-sided ranking diagnostics, not an arbitrary small enumeration or routine normalization check.
